title: Make qualified open-source mechanism reuse the default before original construction
problem: UNIIMENTE already prefers open source and acquire-before-invent, but agents can still rebuild known algorithms or treat public repositories only as references. The founder wants open-source code and information used as construction feedstock to accelerate completion of the full currently achievable mind.
baseline: Existing guidance searches open source before new architecture and prefers local/free software, but it does not consistently distinguish discovery, dependency reuse, vendored source transplants, coherent forks/subtrees and Foundry recombination.

alternatives.name: Standing search rule only
alternatives.description: Tell agents to search GitHub before coding but add no reuse/provenance modes.
disadvantages: Does not control license or provenance
Does not distinguish educational code from production dependencies
Does not prevent whole-repository dependency sprawl
alternatives.revival_evidence: Revive if the five-mode policy creates measurable bureaucracy without reducing duplicate implementation, license risk or dependency burden.

alternatives.name: Wholesale repository mirroring
alternatives.description: Copy or subtree large collections of useful open-source repositories into UNIIMENTE for maximal immediate capability surface.
advantages: Large mechanism surface becomes locally available quickly
disadvantages: Creates large update and security burden
Can duplicate registries, schedulers or control planes
Catalogued code may be mistaken for integrated capability
alternatives.revival_evidence: Revive only for a coherent subsystem whose full boundary is required and whose license, maintenance, security, storage and update economics beat a narrow dependency or source slice.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Existing open-source-first guidance remains, but duplicate custom implementations and inconsistent repository reuse remain possible.
disadvantages: Engineering time can continue to be spent rebuilding solved mechanisms
The founder's explicit 2026-10-01 correction remains under-specified for future agents

roles.position: Preserve the full Body + Organs + Mind destination and make reuse an acceleration mechanism, never a stopping condition or narrowing device.
material_concerns: Agents may convert reuse into another cataloging exercise
Agents may interpret a seed proof as completion

roles.position: Use a source-to-capability pipeline behind canonical GREG interfaces rather than importing external systems as parallel operating planes.
material_concerns: Irreversible coupling to upstream repository structure

roles.position: Reject blanket copy-paste. Require exact provenance, license/security review, stronger baselines and common-mode disclosure.
material_concerns: Educational code masquerading as production code
False independence through wrappers around the same upstream

roles.position: Prefer maintained dependencies behind narrow adapters; vendor only small stable primitives when carrying the upstream dependency is worse.
Open source changes cost and inspectability, not truth, privacy, legality or participant welfare. Every imported mechanism remains subject to evidence and consequence gates.
material_concerns: Claims of correctness based only on repository existence

evidence.claim: The repository already requires acquire-before-invent and open-source-first selection.
evidence.reference: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md on main, inspected 2026-10-01
evidence.finding: Both explicitly require searching existing, commodity and open-source mechanisms before new architecture.

evidence.claim: TheAlgorithms/Python is primarily educational and its own README warns implementations may be less efficient than standard-library implementations.
evidence.finding: Use as a mechanism atlas and possible source of narrow transplants, not as automatic production code.

evidence.claim: TheAlgorithms/Python's repository license permits reuse with retained notice obligations.
evidence.finding: The repository carries an MIT license; exact file/subcomponent terms still require adoption-time verification.

counterevidence.claim: Open source does not eliminate all cost or operational burden.
counterevidence.finding: Hardware, electricity, storage, maintenance, exclusive data and platform costs can remain.

counterevidence.claim: A large repository import can be worse than a small local implementation.
counterevidence.finding: Reject or isolate upstreams when deep irreversible coupling or operational burden exceeds the primitive's value.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Turn existing public technical work into qualified, replaceable construction supply so GREG reaches the full currently achievable machine faster while preserving provenance, authority and evidence.

advantages.statement: Avoid rebuilding solved algorithms and infrastructure.
advantages.amplified_value: Founder and agent effort concentrates on the GREG-specific integration, proof, learning and novel residual mechanisms.

advantages.statement: Increase the available cognitive repertoire quickly.
advantages.amplified_value: P5-P7 can recruit mature graph, symbolic, causal, optimization, control, game and search machinery without inventing each field from first principles.
Upstreams can be upgraded or replaced without becoming constitutional dependencies.
Foundry work begins from a named residual CapabilityDeficit after precedent and reusable mechanisms have been exhausted.

advantages.statement: Convert external engineering history into project learning.
advantages.amplified_value: Mechanism cards preserve assumptions, failures and alternatives even when source code is not imported.

disadvantages.statement: A popular upstream can become a hidden critical dependency.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require pinned provenance, a narrow adapter, a substitute, rollback and a review trigger.

disadvantages.statement: Copied code can create license, attribution, patent or distribution obligations.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require exact adoption-time license/provenance review and prohibit uncertain reuse until resolved.

disadvantages.statement: Repository search can waste time for trivial functions.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Apply proportionality: material capabilities require source search; trivial local utilities may be written directly when search cost clearly exceeds expected reuse value.

disadvantages.statement: Educational/reference algorithms can pass toy tests but be poor production implementations.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Classify educational atlases as DISCOVER-first and require native-domain qualification plus a stronger/simpler baseline before production use.

disadvantages.statement: Multiple apparent implementations can share a common upstream and fail together.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Receipts and verifier profiles disclose shared upstream code, parser, model, dataset and solver dependencies.

comparisons.baseline: Acquire-before-invent exists but repository reuse is under-specified.
comparisons.do_nothing: No process cost, but duplicate implementation and inconsistent qualification remain.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: A single 'search GitHub first' rule is cheaper but does not govern provenance, quality or integration mode.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Wholesale mirroring maximizes local code surface but creates the largest maintenance, licensing and architectural-capture burden.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Install governance, source map and entry-point rules now; prove the pipeline on the next material CapabilityDeficit without importing a large new subsystem.

rejected_alternatives.name: Blanket whole-repository copying
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: It confuses source availability with integrated capability and maximizes coupling.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A bounded coherent subsystem whose full surface is required and demonstrably cheaper/safer to maintain than a narrow adapter or vendored slice.

rejected_alternatives.name: Build everything internally
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: It wastes effort on known mechanisms and contradicts current acquire-before-invent doctrine.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Evidence that available implementations fail license, security, performance, portability or architecture requirements and a local implementation is materially simpler.

pass_2.attack_summary: Assume coding agents optimize for speed and game the shortcut: they may paste attractive code, infer license from a repository badge, import a framework for one function, count a catalog entry as a capability, or call two wrappers independent verification.

new_weaknesses.statement: Qualification records can become documentation work that delays actual coding.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Keep records proportional and attach them only to material adopted mechanisms; discovery-only sources need only concise mechanism cards.

new_weaknesses.statement: Fast-moving upstreams can change behavior or terms after adoption.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Pin immutable versions, record update ownership and re-run qualification when upstream license, API, model weights or security posture changes.

new_weaknesses.statement: Agents can satisfy 'searched open source' by listing popular repositories without testing fit.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: A candidate counts only when its primitive, contract, constraints, license and strongest alternative are recorded; adoption requires native qualification.

new_weaknesses.statement: Vendoring can freeze old vulnerabilities while hiding the upstream update channel.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Vendor only small stable slices and preserve upstream commit/path plus an explicit refresh trigger.

new_weaknesses.statement: A single algorithm/library family can dominate routing and create correlated failure.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Preserve method diversity where it has measured value and require failure-diverse verification for critical claims.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Upstream dependencies are sometimes the correct tradeoff; replaceable adapters, pins, substitutes and review triggers bound the risk.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Upstream failure, abandonment, security advisory or materially better substitute.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: The policy prohibits unresolved reuse and requires exact provenance/license records for code transplants and dependencies.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any redistribution, license change, new subcomponent or legal uncertainty.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Proportionality prevents deep research for trivial functions while retaining mandatory search for material capabilities.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Measured source-search time repeatedly exceeds reuse value for a capability class.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Educational repositories default to DISCOVER and cannot become active capability without independent qualification.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any proposed promotion of educational/example code.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Common dependencies cannot always be eliminated, but they must be disclosed and critical verification must seek fault diversity.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any claim of independent verification or critical-method redundancy.

pass_2.final_design: Five reuse modes govern source use: DISCOVER, DEPEND, VENDOR-SLICE, FORK/SUBTREE and RECOMBINE. Material CapabilityDeficits search qualified internal/open-source mechanisms before original construction. Every adopted external mechanism has pinned provenance, license/security/fit evidence, typed integration, native tests, replacement and rollback. Foundry receives only the residual unsolved mechanism. Reuse accelerates full-machine completion and never creates authority or a stopping condition.

residual_risks.risk: Complex licenses, patents or model/data terms may require professional review.
residual_risks.mitigation: Mark unresolved and do not redistribute or promote until reviewed.
residual_risks.owner: Repository maintainer / authorized counsel when needed

residual_risks.risk: Upstream vulnerabilities or abandonment can appear after adoption.
residual_risks.mitigation: Pin, monitor at material review points, preserve substitutes and test rollback.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Security advisory, maintenance lapse or failed upgrade.

residual_risks.risk: The mechanism atlas can grow faster than integrated capability.
residual_risks.mitigation: Count only exercised mission-path capability as progress; catalogs remain discovery assets.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Any completion claim based on catalog size or unexercised descriptors.

dissent.handling: All five roles were explicitly asked to attack the proposal. The blanket-copy interpretation was rejected and absorbed into the final design; no remaining material dissent blocks the development-selection rule.

migration_plan: Add the intent/source/review/source-map records, wire the rule into AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Copilot instructions, OPEN_SOURCE_STACK.md and the founder ledger, then reference it from the active coordination issue and Cortex PR. No runtime dependency or capability is activated by this migration.

steps: Revert the governance commits on the dedicated branch or later merge commit.
Remove the new source-map references from agent entry points.
Preserve the source record and deliberation history as historical evidence even if the policy is superseded.

kill_criteria: Measured search/qualification effort consistently costs more than the quality/time benefit of reuse for the affected capability class.
The rule repeatedly produces unmanageable license, security, maintenance or architectural coupling that cannot be bounded by adapters or source slices.
A stronger founder-authorized acquisition policy supersedes it.
review_trigger: Next material CapabilityDeficit, first repository-scale import, or any evidence that the policy impedes rather than accelerates full-machine completion.
